svg.title: Interventions and inclusion states
svg.desc: Schematic illustration, not empirical evidence. Catalog-wide changes reorder intact attribute blocks for every product. Single-target changes replace one target while competitors retain raw C0 representations. Three rows show 1,1,1 persistent inclusion; 1,0,1 cutoff crossing; and 0,0,0 persistent omission.
